adoption: a separate adoption record after an independent review; design only
contract_version_and_schemas: unchanged (0.2.0): nothing has been implemented, prepared or executed under 0.2.0; every 0.2.0 result names the design revision it follows

evidence: tests/test_supervisor_darwin_v01.py at a23761919e92c41489f26a57d02fa1d5dc9d8e19 (observation test and the MC12/MC13 development cases)
W1's 12 runs: MC12 failed 10, MC13 timeout 3, MC13 cancellation 1, positive 0, every failure PermissionError
finding.effect_on_adopted_S4: the imported group_exists treats only ESRCH as an answer, so EPERM escapes as PermissionError through terminate_group; terminate_group's three killpg signal sends catch only ProcessLookupError; the caller receives PermissionError instead of the original Stop, the cleanup receipt stays empty, and the direct child can remain unreaped

reimplemented.run_process: as adopted: only the precondition differs; its body's names group_exists and terminate_group resolve to the Darwin re-implementations
reimplemented.group_exists: the same probe os.killpg(pid, 0); True when it returns or fails with PermissionError (EPERM); False only on ProcessLookupError (ESRCH); any other error propagates unchanged
reimplemented.terminate_group: the original logic, limits, order and receipt; in each of its three os.killpg(..., SIGTERM|SIGKILL) sends a PermissionError is treated like ProcessLookupError (the send is passed over); its polling uses the Darwin group_exists

decision.rule: the group counts as absent only when the probe reports ESRCH; the rule holds whichever answer a group of unreaped members gives
decision.fail_closed: a genuine permission refusal also answers EPERM, counts as present, and a group that never empties fails at the cleanup ceiling with the original Stop; a send failing with EPERM is never taken as proof of absence
decision.original_supervisor: byte-identical; stays the Linux contract's supervisor

replaces.CONTRACT.md section 1 row S4: a Darwin variant whose only changes are the precondition and the counting of an EPERM group answer as a present group
replaces.CONTRACT.md section 5 imports and re-imp: imports Clock, Stop, LIMITS, inventory, json_bytes and _reap unchanged; re-implements run_process, group_exists and terminate_group
replaces.CONTRACT.md section 5 token comparison: a reviewed token-level comparison of the three re-implemented functions with the originals shows only the precondition block of run_process, the PermissionError clause of group_exists and the PermissionError additions to the three except clauses of terminate_group
replaces.CONTRACT.md section 5 process_group_abse: the same probe failed with ESRCH; a group of only unreaped members answers EPERM on this host and counts as present; absent means no member, live or unreaped, remains; a genuine permission refusal also counts as present and fails closed at the cleanup ceiling
replaces.CONTRACT.md section 5 cleanup.passed: the group became absent (ESRCH) within the cleanup ceiling, with the meanings of reaped and process_group_absent above
